results.text:
Clue - Agentic ABM for modern GTM teams

# Agentic ABM for modern GTM teams

Build every campaign around the account, then carry it from first signal to market without losing context, quality, or control.

Get Early Access

[00] The problem/ Why ABM breaks

## ABM was never limited by ambition.It was limited by the amount of work.

Genuine 1:1 execution requires

research, strategy, copy, design,audience creation, media operations,sales alignment, and constant coordination.

Agents remove the production bottleneck.

## IntroducingClue

AI agents for end-to-end ABM execution

[01] Platform/ How Clue works

### Research every account.Build every campaign.Launch without the handoffs.

Five specialized agents turn account context into one coherent campaign — from research and strategy through activation and measurement.

### Research every account.Build every campaign.Launch without the handoffs.

Five specialized agents turn account context into one coherent campaign — from research and strategy through activation and measurement.

## Know the company, the people and the moment

Clue brings together 50+ company, market, intent, leadership and personal signals plus the custom data points your team cares about into one sourced account.

It reveals what is changing, who matters and where the strongest campaign opportunity exists.

## Turn the research into one campaign idea

Clue defines the central angle, message hierarchy, stakeholder narratives, offer and creative direction that every campaign asset will follow.

One clear brief keeps the entire campaign grounded in why this account should care now.

## Give every account a destination built around its priorities

Clue creates a dedicated microsite with the right story, proof, offer and call to action for the company and every person involved in the decision.

Not a page with the company name swapped in, an experience shaped around the account.

## Carry one campaign idea across every stage of attention

Clue builds coordinated LinkedIn and Meta campaigns for awareness, consideration and conversion, with every ad connected to the same account strategy.

The message changes by audience and stage without losing the idea that holds the campaign together.

## Turn account insight into something they will remember

Clue creates the concept, copy and package for direct mail from founder letters and executive reports to hand written notes tied directly to the campaign story.

Every detail feels considered because it begins with the account, not the format.

[02] Capabilities/ Built for production

## Scale the work that never scaled

No more choosing where personalization stops

### Custom research

Define the questions, sources, and signals Clue investigates for every account.

### Buying committees

Map the people behind each decision and build precise role-based audiences.

### Brand intelligence

Keep every campaign aligned to your positioning, voice, proof, and visual system.

### Native activation

Sync audiences and creative across LinkedIn, Meta, CRM, sales, and direct mail.

### Human in the loop

Review the strategy, refine the creative, and approve what goes live.

### Engagement intelligence

See how each account responds and where marketing or sales should act next.

[03] Scale/ High-touch at any volume

## High-touch marketing is no longer scarce

The depth once reserved for ten strategic accounts can now extend across the entire market without adding the team required to produce it.

### More accounts, same standard

Expand coverage without replacing thoughtful work with generic templates.

### More relevance, less production

Spend less time assembling campaigns and more time deciding where to compete.

### More output, same headcount

Scale research, strategy, and execution without scaling the organization behind it.

[04] Impact/ Before and with Clue

## Let marketers direct the campaign, not assemble it

Clue gives your team finished campaign systems to direct and improve

Before

### Your best marketers spend their time assembling campaigns

Days lost gathering account context

Strategy scattered across teams and tools

Creative rebuilt for every channel

High-touch work capped by headcount

With Clue

### They spend it deciding how to win

Deep account research arrives ready to use

One campaign direction stays intact

Agents build and adapt every touchpoint

The same team covers far more accounts
